**Title:** Where the Portland Trail Blazers stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Portland Trail Blazers in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #23 Deni Avdija 62.6
- #52 Donovan Clingan 57.4
- #107 Jrue Holiday 51.7
- #119 Robert Williams 50.3
- #140 Ja Morant 47.8
- #151 Damian Lillard 47.4
- #161 Shaedon Sharpe 46.5
- #175 Toumani Camara 45.7

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
